tests/test_document.py::test_list_open_d.rationale: The old test protected the wrong operation: recent lists history, open lists currently opened documents. Replaced by test_list_open_docs_uses_current_documents_operation.

tests/test_document.py::test_open_doc_wr.rationale: The old test asserted a read operation that never opens a document. Replaced by exact-name resolution and execute-document-open request tests.

tests/test_document.py::test_list_open_d.rationale: Asserts the complete recorded request uses document/open, checked against the installed Fusion MCP schema. Does not claim cloud-file opening.

tests/test_document.py::test_list_projec.rationale: The entire call list proves the projects query is dispatched once with no unintended arguments.

tests/test_document.py::test_search_docs.rationale: Asserts query type, operation, document name and project filter, preventing dropped project scope.
Specifically prevents serializing an absent project filter; the complementary test covers its inclusion.

tests/test_document.py::test_open_doc_by.rationale: An explicit file ID must send one execute open request, without fuzzy search or a read-only listing.

tests/test_document.py::test_open_doc_re.rationale: A plausible fuzzy near-match is present; only the exact match ID is opened, and the search retains project scope.
Six cases cover absent, fuzzy-only, duplicate exact, missing-ID, malformed-entry and malformed-list results. Each checks both the error and absence of execute calls.

tests/test_document.py::test_open_doc_pr.rationale: The identical failed search envelope must return with no open request, preserving error information and avoiding blind retries.

tests/test_document.py::test_open_doc_bl.rationale: Blank input is rejected before any adapter operation, preventing an unscoped cloud search.

tests/test_document.py::test_save_as_ref.rationale: No documented local-path SaveAs exists in the discovered MCP schema. The test requires a structured refusal and zero save calls.

tests/test_document.py::test_save_passes.rationale: Checks the exact save request, guarding against unsupported guessed parameters. No real cloud save is claimed.

tests/test_document.py::test_close_with_.rationale: Maps an explicit save choice to the documented flag without a discard flag.
Maps an explicit discard choice to the documented flag without a save flag.
Prevents silently claiming confirmation when the caller requested no save/discard decision.

tests/test_document.py::test_close_rejec.rationale: Checks error code and zero adapter calls so an unknown confirmation cannot close a document.

tests/test_document.py::test_undo_calls_.rationale: Checks all three calls and operation kinds, detecting dropped, duplicated, or reversed history operations.

tests/test_document.py::test_undo_reject.rationale: Boundary case verifies an error and zero mutations for an empty undo count.

tests/test_document.py::test_redo_calls_.rationale: Checks the exact default redo call instead of relying on the fake success envelope.

tests/test_document.py::test_undo_stops_.rationale: Removed an unused adapter setup; checks the actual loop stops after its first failed operation and propagates the error.

tests/test_document.py::test_history_rej.rationale: Both undo/redo reject negative, zero, fractional, string, boolean and null counts before adapter calls, including Python bool's int-subclass trap.

tests/test_document.py::test_history_pre.rationale: Both operations succeed once then fail, proving the loop returns the failure and stops at two calls rather than continuing the requested four.
